name: Tidepool
manual_export_steps: Sign in at app.tidepool.org and confirm your pump or CGM data is present.
Choose Export Data in the blue navigation bar (clinician accounts: select the person with diabetes first).
Select a date range up to 90 days, choose mg/dL or mmol/L, and choose JSON.
Choose Export and keep the downloaded TidepoolExport.json on this computer, then return here and choose that file.
registration_note: Tidepool has paused new Client IDs, and its personal API signs in with the account password for a session token, which Clippi-Health never collects. Direct connection stays disabled until Tidepool publishes a verified public-client OAuth profile.
direct_note: Tidepool is not SMART-on-FHIR and publishes no verified local OAuth profile. Use the JSON export above; daily glucose, insulin, and carb rows are projected to charts with the raw export authoritative. Where Tidepool and Apple Health overlap on a day and metric, the Tidepool value is used.
